reel_angle.fan_question: How did a PSG side with two thirds of the ball drop their first Champions League points?
reel_angle.data_answer: Possession isn't chances: PSG had 66% of the ball and 698 passes to 348, but Roma had 2.69 xG to 1.78, 1.65 open-play xG to 0.74 and 4 big chances to 2. PSG's goals came from a corner and a penalty.
